description: §66.3 rule 9 (i) / §6.14.1 rule 5: `let <zoom=(@base * 2) persist="local" key=…/>` is inferable within the file, but its type is a storage contract read on every load — so without `:T` it is E-DECL-TYPE-REQUIRED-AT-BOUNDARY (reported instead of, not beside, any inference code).
rationale: §6.14.1 rule 5: "A `persist=` cell whose initializer is not a literal SHALL be written with `:T`; without it, `E-DECL-TYPE-REQUIRED-AT-BOUNDARY`"; §66.3 rule 9: "reported INSTEAD of rule 7's code". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "go on the package" (dd own-value-type-annotation-o35d-dpa-065 §8 ruling 7).
